IngestEvent.description: The producer-facing event shape submitted by the MCP tap, SDK, or OTLP normalizer. The collector derives the canonical event from it: tenant_id comes from the ingest token (never the body), payload is redacted/truncated/digested server-side, and chain fields are computed at ingest.

credential_ref.description: Fingerprint reference; never a secret value
credential_ref.title: Credential Ref

payload.description: Raw captured content. Redacted, truncated, digested, and split from the event server-side. Producers should pre-redact as defense in depth.
payload.title: Payload
